import ImbalancedChen.Part3PairedAlphaDeletion
import ImbalancedChen.Part3SharedFirstFactorDispersion
import ImbalancedChen.Part3SmoothCoprimeError
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real

/-!
# The actual cleaned common-p row has one uniformly short progression

The row is the literal cleaned/transposed beta carrier with the signed
target-divisor deletion and the original product congruence. Its modulus
is an arbitrary integer factor from the primitive first-factor carrier.
No primality of p or admissibility of the transposed atom is assumed.

Nonzero common smoothing supplies the real endpoints V/2 <= m <= 3V,
including positivity even though its finite carrier contains zero. An
occupied row supplies coprimality, and the original Q1 geometry supplies
the uniform 3U/Q1 cardinal bound for the later common-p row Cauchy step.
No divisor-fiber sum, shifted moment or analytic estimate is proved here.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen.Part3

noncomputable section

open Classical Finset Set

def MediumAtom.cleanedCommonPProgression (d : MediumAtom) (p m : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.betaCarrier.filter
    (fun n => ¬(n : ℤ) ∣ d.residue ∧
      Int.ModEq p ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue)

namespace CommonPFiniteReduction

private theorem q1_lt_U
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (hsigma : 0 < sigma) :
    d.Q1 < d.U := by
  have hU0 : 0 ≤ d.U := zero_le_one.trans hd.1
  have hx : 1 ≤ d.scale := by
    change 1 ≤ d.U * d.V
    calc
      1 = (1 : ℝ) * 1 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ d.U * d.V := mul_le_mul hd.1 hd.2.1 zero_le_one hU0
  have hpow : d.scale ^ (-sigma) ≤ 1 :=
    Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos hx (neg_nonpos.mpr hsigma.le)
  have hgeom : d.Q1 < d.U * d.scale ^ (-sigma) :=
    hd.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  exact hgeom.trans_le (by
    simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow hU0)

end CommonPFiniteReduction

/-- The occupied original cleaned row retains its signed residue and
deletion gate. A nonzero common smooth weight gives its true physical
endpoints; the original primitive factor and full admissibility give
the coprimality and 3U/Q1 count, without a restriction on kappa. -/
theorem MediumAtom.cleaned_commonP_progression_geometry
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (hsigma : 0 < sigma)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier) (m : ℕ)
    (hpsi : d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight m ≠ 0)
    (hrow : (d.cleanedCommonPProgression p m).Nonempty) :
    d.V / 2 ≤ (m : ℝ) ∧ (m : ℝ) ≤ 3 * d.V ∧ 0 < m ∧
      m.Coprime p ∧
        ((d.cleanedCommonPProgression p m).card : ℝ) ≤ 3 * d.U / d.Q1 := by
  have hU0 : 0 ≤ d.U := zero_le_one.trans hd.1
  have hVpos : 0 < d.V := zero_lt_one.trans_le hd.2.1
  have hQpos : 0 < d.Q1 := zero_lt_one.trans_le hd.2.2.1
  have hweight : CommonSmoothCutoff.scaledDyadicCutoff d.V (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [MediumAtom.commonSmoothWeight, MediumAtom.transposedAtom,
      MediumAtom.cleanedAlphaAtom] using hpsi
  have hmSupport : (m : ℝ) ∈
      tsupport (CommonSmoothCutoff.scaledDyadicCutoff d.V) :=
    subset_closure hweight
  have hmBounds := CommonSmoothCutoff.scaledDyadicCutoff_tsupport_subset hVpos hmSupport
  have hmpos : 0 < m := by
    have hmReal : (0 : ℝ) < m := (half_pos hVpos).trans_le hmBounds.1
    exact_mod_cast hmReal
  have hpCarrier : p ∈ factorCarrier d.Q1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1
  have hpLower : d.Q1 ≤ (p : ℝ) :=
    (Nat.le_ceil d.Q1).trans (by
      exact_mod_cast (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hpCarrier).1)
  have hppos : 0 < p := by
    exact_mod_cast hQpos.trans_le hpLower
  have ha : Int.gcd d.residue p = 1 := by
    simpa only [Int.gcd, Int.natAbs_natCast] using (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2.symm
  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := hrow
  have hmod : Int.ModEq p ((m : ℤ) * n0) d.residue :=
    (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn0).2.2
  have hunit : m.Coprime p :=
    (CommonSmoothCutoff.coprime_of_product_congruent ha hmod).1
  have hsub : d.cleanedCommonPProgression p m ⊆
      d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.betaCarrier.filter
        (fun n : ℕ => Int.ModEq p ((n : ℤ) * m) d.residue) := by
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨hnCarrier, _hdelete, hnmod⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hn
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hnCarrier, by simpa only [mul_comm] using hnmod⟩
  have hprogression :
      ((d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.betaCarrier.filter
        (fun n : ℕ => Int.ModEq p ((n : ℤ) * m) d.residue)).card : ℝ) ≤
          2 * d.U / (p : ℝ) + 1 := by
    exact PairedAlphaDeletion.betaCarrier_progression_card_le
      (d := d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom)
      (show 1 ≤ d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.V from hd.1) hppos hunit
  have hQU : d.Q1 < d.U := CommonPFiniteReduction.q1_lt_U hd hsigma
  have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ d.U / d.Q1 := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hQpos).mpr
    simpa only [one_mul] using hQU.le
  have hdiv : 2 * d.U / (p : ℝ) ≤ 2 * d.U / d.Q1 :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hU0) hQpos hpLower
  refine ⟨hmBounds.1, hmBounds.2, hmpos, hunit, ?_⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ ((d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.betaCarrier.filter
        (fun n : ℕ => Int.ModEq p ((n : ℤ) * m) d.residue)).card : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card hsub
    _ ≤ 2 * d.U / (p : ℝ) + 1 := hprogression
    _ ≤ 2 * d.U / d.Q1 + 1 := add_le_add hdiv le_rfl
    _ ≤ 2 * d.U / d.Q1 + d.U / d.Q1 := add_le_add_left hone _
    _ = 3 * d.U / d.Q1 := by ring

end

end ImbalancedChen.Part3

structure MediumAtom where
  U : ℝ
  V : ℝ
  Q1 : ℝ
  Q2 : ℝ
  Q3 : ℝ
  residue : ℤ
  intervalLo : ℝ
  intervalHi : ℝ
  alpha : ℕ → ℂ
  beta : ℕ → ℂ
  gamma1 : ℕ → ℂ
  gamma2 : ℕ → ℂ
  gamma3 : ℕ → ℂ

def MediumAtom.scale (d : MediumAtom) : ℝ := d.U * d.V

def MediumAtom.alphaCarrier (d : MediumAtom) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Finset.Icc (Nat.ceil d.U) (Nat.floor (2 * d.U))).filter
    (fun n => d.intervalLo < (n : ℝ) ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ d.intervalHi)

def MediumAtom.betaCarrier (d : MediumAtom) : Finset ℕ :=
  Finset.Icc (Nat.ceil d.V) (Nat.floor (2 * d.V))

/-- Concrete dyadic support `Q ≤ q ≤ 2Q`, including the trivial factor
`q=1` at `Q=1`. The manuscript writes `q ≍ Q`; the compiler must assign
overlapping endpoints without multiplicity loss when it chooses its atoms. -/
def factorCarrier (Q : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  Finset.Icc (Nat.ceil Q) (Nat.floor (2 * Q))

def MediumAdmissible (B : ℕ) (σ κ c0 : ℝ) (d : MediumAtom) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ d.U ∧ 1 ≤ d.V ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q1 ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q2 ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q3 ∧
  Real.exp (Real.exp 1) < d.scale ∧
  c0 * d.scale ≤ (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ∧
  (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ≤ d.scale ^ (1 + κ) ∧
  d.Q1 < d.U * d.scale ^ (-σ) ∧
  d.U ^ 2 * d.Q2 * d.Q3 ^ 2 < d.scale ^ (1 - 8 * σ) ∧
  (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ^ (7 / 32 : ℝ) * d.U * d.Q1 * d.Q2 ^ 5 * d.Q3 ^ 2 <
    d.scale ^ (2 - 15 * σ) ∧
  d.U ^ (1 + 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) * d.Q1 *
      d.Q2 ^ (5 - 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) * d.Q3 ^ (2 + 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) <
    d.scale ^ (2 - 15 * σ) ∧
  (∀ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier, ‖d.alpha n‖ ≤ 1) ∧
  (∀ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier, d.alpha n ≠ 0 → ∀ p : ℕ,
    Nat.Prime p → p ∣ n →
      d.scale ^ (1 / (Real.log (Real.log d.scale)) ^ 3) < (p : ℝ)) ∧
  (∀ m ∈ d.betaCarrier, ‖d.beta m‖ ≤ (m.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ B) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q1, ‖d.gamma1 q‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (d.gamma1 q ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime q d.residue.natAbs)) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2, ‖d.gamma2 q‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (d.gamma2 q ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime q d.residue.natAbs)) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q3, ‖d.gamma3 q‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (d.gamma3 q ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime q d.residue.natAbs))

theorem mediumAdmissible_cleanedAlphaAtom
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) :
    MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d.cleanedAlphaAtom := by
  obtain ⟨hU, hV, hQ1, hQ2, hQ3, hx, ha0, ha1, hg1, hg2, hg3, hg4,
    hAlpha, hRough, hBeta, hGamma1, hGamma2, hGamma3⟩ := hd
  refine ⟨hU, hV, hQ1, hQ2, hQ3, hx, ha0, ha1, hg1, hg2, hg3, hg4,
    ?_, ?_, hBeta, hGamma1, hGamma2, hGamma3⟩
  · intro n hn
    change ‖d.cleanedAlpha n‖ ≤ 1
    by_cases h : (n : ℤ) ∣ d.residue
    · simp only [MediumAtom.cleanedAlpha, if_pos h, norm_zero, zero_le_one]
    · simpa only [MediumAtom.cleanedAlpha, if_neg h] using hAlpha n hn
  · intro n hn hnz p hp hpn
    apply hRough n hn _ p hp hpn
    change d.cleanedAlpha n ≠ 0 at hnz
    by_cases h : (n : ℤ) ∣ d.residue
    · exact (hnz (by simp only [MediumAtom.cleanedAlpha, if_pos h])).elim
    · simpa only [MediumAtom.cleanedAlpha, if_neg h] using hnz

theorem MediumAtom.cleanedAlpha_transposedBeta_ne_zero_not_dvd {d : MediumAtom} {n : ℕ}
    (hn : d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.beta n ≠ 0) : ¬(n : ℤ) ∣ d.residue := by
  change (if n ∈ d.alphaCarrier then d.cleanedAlpha n else 0) ≠ 0 at hn
  by_cases hm : n ∈ d.alphaCarrier
  · exact d.cleanedAlpha_ne_zero_not_dvd (by simpa only [if_pos hm] using hn)
  · exact (hn (by simp only [if_neg hm])).elim

theorem card_product_modEq_le (K q n : ℕ) (a : ℤ) (hn : n.Coprime q) :
    ((Icc 0 K).filter (fun m : ℕ ↦ Int.ModEq q ((m : ℤ) * n) a)).card ≤
      K / q + 1 := by
  calc
    _ ≤ (range (K / q + 1)).card := by
      apply card_le_card_of_injOn (fun m : ℕ ↦ m / q)
      · intro m hm
        exact mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le
          (Nat.div_le_div_right (mem_Icc.mp (mem_filter.mp hm).1).2))
      · intro m hm b hb he
        apply Nat.ext_div_modEq he

theorem betaCarrier_progression_card_le
    {d : MediumAtom} (hV : 1 ≤ d.V) {q n : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (hn : n.Coprime q) :
    ((d.betaCarrier.filter
      (fun m : ℕ ↦ Int.ModEq q ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue)).card : ℝ) ≤
        2 * d.V / q + 1 := by
  have hsub : d.betaCarrier.filter
      (fun m : ℕ ↦ Int.ModEq q ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue) ⊆
      (Icc 0 (Nat.floor (2 * d.V))).filter
        (fun m : ℕ ↦ Int.ModEq q ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue) := by
    intro m hm
    obtain ⟨hm, hap⟩ := mem_filter.mp hm
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_Icc.mpr ⟨Nat.zero_le _, (mem_Icc.mp hm).2⟩, hap⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ ((Nat.floor (2 * d.V) / q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans
        (card_product_modEq_le (Nat.floor (2 * d.V)) q n d.residue hn)
    _ ≤ (Nat.floor (2 * d.V) : ℝ) / q + 1 := by
      push_cast
      have hh : ((Nat.floor (2 * d.V) / q : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
          (Nat.floor (2 * d.V) : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) := Nat.cast_div_le
      exact add_le_add hh le_rfl
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add
      (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Nat.floor_le (by linarith : 0 ≤ 2 * d.V))
        (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) by exact_mod_cast hq.le)) le_rfl

namespace ImbalancedChen.Part3

noncomputable section

open Classical Finset
open scoped BigOperators

namespace CommonSmoothCutoff

theorem coprime_of_product_congruent {a : ℤ} {q m n : ℕ}
    (ha : Int.gcd a q = 1) (h : Int.ModEq q ((m : ℤ) * n) a) :
    m.Coprime q ∧ n.Coprime q := by
  have hg : Int.gcd ((m : ℤ) * n) q = 1 := by
    rw [← Int.gcd_emod ((m : ℤ) * n) q, h.eq, Int.gcd_emod, ha]
  have hmn : (m * n).Coprime q := by
    simpa [Int.gcd, Int.natAbs_mul] using hg
  exact Nat.coprime_mul_iff_left.mp hmn
end CommonSmoothCutoff

/-- See `le_div_iff₀'` for a version with multiplication on the other side. -/
lemma le_div_iff₀ (hc : 0 < c) : a ≤ b / c ↔ a * c ≤ b := by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, le_mul_inv_iff₀ hc]

-- Not a `mono` lemma b/c `div_le_div₀` is strictly more general
lemma div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hc : 0 < c) (h : c ≤ b) : a / b ≤ a / c := by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv]
  gcongr
  exacts [ha, hc]
